title: Facility, policy, validation and quality assurance conditions for technician stocking of automated dispensing devices under Policy 2023-08
subtopic: Technician stocking of automated dispensing devices: general requirements
rule_summary: Board of Registration in Pharmacy, Drug Control Program and Bureau of Healthcare Safety and Quality Policy 2023-08, Pharmacy Technician Stocking of Automated Dispensing Devices (adopted 6/1/23), permits Board-licensed pharmacy technicians to perform certain medication inventory and stocking functions related to ADDs. Under its General Requirements, the permitted activities may only occur within Massachusetts-licensed health care facilities (e.g., hospitals) that have on-site pharmacies and have the ADDs located at the same physical address as listed on the facility's Massachusetts Controlled Substances Registration; the pharmacy must determine if any approvals or other notices are required by the licensing authority of the health care facility; the pharmacy must have policies and procedures in place for the permitted activities, including training requirements; the general ADD requirements of Policy 2019-02 must be followed; a licensed health care professional must use an electronic device with bar code scanning or other electronic validation for product verification upon removal from an ADD and/or upon patient administration; and, for quality assurance, a designated Board-licensed individual must verify all ADD transactions to account for the inventory sent from the pharmacy or expected to be received by the pharmacy (e.g., expired medications), monitor all ADD access, and track and trend data for accuracy and compliance, and random audits must be conducted at various points in the inventory and stocking process, for instance audits of the ADD's physical contents. The stocking activities themselves are for ADDs located in a patient care area.
exam_relevance: Tests the threshold conditions that must be met before any technician stocking pathway in Policy 2023-08 is available: a licensed health care facility with an on-site pharmacy, the ADD at the address on the facility's MCSR, written procedures with training, bar code validation by the licensed professional at removal or administration, and the designated licensee's quality assurance duties.

authority.name: Policy 2023-08: Pharmacy Technician Stocking of Automated Dispensing Devices (ADD)

common_confusions: Using a Policy 2023-08 stocking pathway at a facility without an on-site pharmacy or at an ADD address different from the facility's MCSR.

Treating the technician's own barcode scan while loading as the only validation step, when the policy also requires validation by the licensed health care professional upon removal and/or administration.
verification_notes: Policy 2023-08 read in the mass.gov PDF linked from the current Pharmacy Practice Resources list (page header: Adopted 6/1/23) during the authoring session of 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-17.
